YOUR COMPANION’S VOICE

Mochi’s speaking voice.

A brighter, higher-pitched voice that speaks the words in Mochi’s bubble. Try the greeting, then adjust it to your taste.

A little code, a little wonder.

Start your adventure and hatch the egg. Then write assignments in the coding panel. Choice buttons show a hint; you type the code yourself. Complete a valid line and watch the world update as you type.

Keep earlier lines and add the next one beneath them. You can change a value anytime. The safe prototype recognizes the chapter’s illustrated commands, rather than running arbitrary Python. Your world lasts until you restart or reload. A quiet breeze, occasional birdsong and Mochi’s spoken dialogue accompany the journey.
